summary: Project involves a distribution recording application with beneficiary management features, including a checklist-based beneficiary selection system per village.
architectural_notes: Beneficiary selection in distribution recording uses a checklist system sourced from existing target (sasaran) data, organized per village (desa)

existing_features.title: In the 'Catat Distribusi' (Record Distribution) page, replace the free-text beneficiary name input with a searchable checklist selector that pulls data from the existing Sasaran (beneficiary) records. The checklist must group beneficiaries by village (desa), allowing the inputter to expand each village group and check/uncheck individual beneficiaries. Multiple beneficiaries can be selected at once before submitting the distribution record.

new_feature_requests.summary: Pada menu 'Catat Distribusi', input nama penerima manfaat menggunakan sistem ceklis yang diambil dari data sasaran, dikelompokkan per desa

Update the backend distribution recording logic to accept a list of selected beneficiary IDs (one per distribution entry or as a batch), so that when multiple beneficiaries are checked in the form, each receives their own distribution record linked to the selected package and date.
